description: Buried surface per BAG1 residue at the PSMD2/Rpn1 interface in cryo-EM entry 9HEU
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, collections, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"})
txt=S.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/9HEU.cif",timeout=300).text
print("9HEU cif chars:",len(txt))
lines=txt.split("\n"); i=0
while not lines[i].startswith("_atom_site."): i+=1
hdr=[]
while lines[i].startswith("_atom_site."): hdr.append(lines[i].strip().split(".")[1]); i+=1
rows=[]
while not lines[i].startswith("#"):
    p=lines[i].split()
    if len(p)==len(hdr): rows.append(p)
    i+=1
c={h:k for k,h in enumerate(hdr)}
ch=np.array([r[c["auth_asym_id"]] for r in rows]); resi=np.array([int(r[c["auth_seq_id"]]) for r in rows])
resn=np.array([r[c["auth_comp_id"]] for r in rows]); el=np.array([r[c["type_symbol"]] for r in rows])
xyz=np.array([[float(r[c["Cartn_x"]]),float(r[c["Cartn_y"]]),float(r[c["Cartn_z"]])] for r in rows])
OFF=115
bag=ch=="x"; B=xyz[bag]; Bres=resi[bag]+OFF; Bel=el[bag]
lo,hi=B.min(0)-8,B.max(0)+8
sel=(~bag)&np.all((xyz>lo)&(xyz<hi),axis=1)
O=xyz[sel]
# buried area per BAG1 residue: SASA in isolation minus SASA in complex
VDW={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80}
def sph(n=200):
    k=np.arange(n)+0.5; phi=np.arccos(1-2*k/n); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*k
    return np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(phi),np.sin(th)*np.sin(phi),np.cos(phi)]
SP=sph(200)
def sasa(X,E,extra=None):
    R=np.array([VDW.get(e,1.7) for e in E])+1.4
    out=np.zeros(len(X))
    allX=X if extra is None else np.vstack([X,extra])
    allR=R if extra is None else np.concatenate([R,np.full(len(extra),1.7+1.4)])
    for a in range(len(X)):
        d=np.linalg.norm(allX-X[a],axis=1); nb=np.where((d<R[a]+allR)&(d>1e-6))[0]
        pts=X[a]+R[a]*SP; acc=np.ones(len(SP),bool)
        for b in nb: acc&=(np.linalg.norm(pts-allX[b],axis=1)>=allR[b])
        out[a]=4*np.pi*R[a]**2*acc.mean()
    return out
free=sasa(B,Bel); bound=sasa(B,Bel,extra=O)
bur=collections.defaultdict(float); aa={}
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
for k in range(len(B)):
    bur[int(Bres[k])]+=free[k]-bound[k]; aa[int(Bres[k])]=AA3.get(resn[bag][k],'X')
patch={151:'L8',189:'R42',191:'I44',192:'F45',195:'K48',196:'Q49',216:'H68',218:'V70',219:'L71',220:'R72'}
worm={151:'S8',189:'K49',191:'L51',192:'H52',195:'K55',196:'F56',216:'I77',218:'M79',219:'G80',220:'G81'}
tot=sum(bur.values()); print(f"total BAG1 surface buried by PSMD2/Rpn1 = {tot:.0f} A^2")
ordered=sorted(bur.items(), key=lambda kv:-kv[1])[:20]
print("\n top buried BAG1 residues (UniProt Q99933 numbering):")
for r,v in ordered:
    print(f"   {aa[r]}{r:<4} {v:6.1f} A^2   ubq-equivalent: {patch.get(r,'-'):<4}  worm BAG-1: {worm.get(r,'-')}")
pct=sum(v for r,v in bur.items() if r in patch)/tot*100
print(f"\n{pct:.0f}% of the buried BAG1 surface comes from the 10 Ile44-patch-equivalent positions")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,4.5))
rs=sorted(bur); vals=[bur[r] for r in rs]
cols=["#E45756" if r in patch else "#BBBBBB" for r in rs]
ax.bar(rs,vals,color=cols,width=0.9)
for r in patch:
    if bur[r]>8: ax.annotate(f"{aa[r]}{r}\n({patch[r]}-eq)\nworm {worm[r]}",(r,bur[r]),textcoords="offset points",
                             xytext=(0,4),ha="center",fontsize=6.5)
ax.set_xlabel("human BAG1 residue (UniProt Q99933)"); ax.set_ylabel(r"surface buried by PSMD2/Rpn1 ($\AA^2$)")
ax.set_title("Cryo-EM 9HEU: the BAG1 ubiquitin-like domain binds the 26S proteasome subunit PSMD2 (Rpn1)\n"
             "through the surface equivalent to the ubiquitin Ile44 patch (red); worm BAG-1 residue given below each")
ax.axvspan(144,224,color="#4C78A8",alpha=0.08)
ax.text(184,max(vals)*0.95,"ubiquitin-like domain 144-224",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#4C78A8")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
pd.DataFrame([dict(resi=r,aa=aa[r],buried_A2=round(bur[r],1),ubq_equiv=patch.get(r,""),worm_BAG1=worm.get(r,"")) for r in rs if bur[r]>0]).to_csv("/tmp/iface.csv",index=False)
